newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens in global data comms alliance.
newsitem.headline: Siemens in global data comms alliance.

text.p: Siemens AG said on Thursday it had agreed on forming an alliance with a "leading global manufacturer of data communications products and solutions" but declined to name its partner.
The company made the announcement in an invitation to a news conference about the deal, to take place on July 9 in Munich.

The company said in the invitation that the global market for integrated data, voice and multimedia services, such as Internet telephony, was expected to grow 17 percent a year and be worth some 150 billion marks ($85.5 billion) by the year 2000.
But it declined to give any further details in response to Reuters enquiries.
